newsitem.title: CHINA: China to roll out new light helicopter in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China to roll out new light helicopter in 1997.

text.p: China will start production next year of a new light helicopter developed jointly with France and Singapore, and total demand could reach 1,600, the China Daily newspaper said on Monday.
Output of the five-seat multipurpose EC120 helicopter would reach 18 in 1998, the newspaper quoted Chinese officials as saying.

The EC120 is jointly produced by Franco-German firm Eurocopter, which owns 61 percent of the venture, Singapore Aerospace Ltd which owns 15 percent and the China National Aero-Technology Import and Export Corp (CATIC), which holds the remainder.
Market surveys for the helicopter, suitable for both military and civilian use, suggested world demand of around 1,600, the newspaper said but gave no details.
The EC120 programme started in 1992, with the helicopter making its maiden flight in 1995, it said.
The helicopter was expected to be certified by France's Joint Airworthiness Authority by the end of 1996, it said.
Cooperation with other countries had helped to train Chinese helicopter engineers and would boost China's helicopter industry, long hampered by poor quality, the newspaper said.
